title: fix(hooks): find node from nvm, fnm, volta, asdf, mise and homebrew
note: injection_risk: In hooks/run-node.sh, the added lines glue environment variables into file paths with no allow-list, and those paths are then globbed and executed: `add "${NVM_DIR:-$home/.nvm}/versions/node"` (likewise FNM_DIR, VOLTA_HOME, ASDF_DATA_DIR, MISE_DATA_DIR, N_PREFIX) and `run_with "$sys$p"` with sys=${JEV_HOOKS_TEST_SYSROOT}. The definition counts the environment as outside data and a file path as a sink, which fits other_sink. The execs are quoted argument lists, though, not shell strings, so a reader could also call this safe launcher code.
